mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_student_task_state (dept_id, lesson_id, question_id, student_id, task_state, state_version, changed_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{deptId}, #{lessonId}, #{questionId}, #{studentId}, #{taskState}, 1, #{changedAt}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state_version = state_version + CASE WHEN task_state <> VALUES(task_state) AND ( VALUES(task_state) IN ('SUBMITTED', 'GRADED', 'RETURNED') OR (VALUES(task_state) = 'WORKING' AND task_state IN ('NOT_ENTERED', 'ENTERED', 'WORKING', 'RETURNED')) OR (VALUES(task_state) = 'ENTERED' AND task_state IN ('NOT_ENTERED', 'ENTERED')) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, dept_id = CASE WHEN VALUES(task_state) IN ('SUBMITTED', 'GRADED', 'RETURNED') OR (VALUES(task_state) = 'WORKING' AND task_state IN ('NOT_ENTERED', 'ENTERED', 'WORKING', 'RETURNED')) OR (VALUES(task_state) = 'ENTERED' AND task_state IN ('NOT_ENTERED', 'ENTERED')) THEN VALUES(dept_id) ELSE dept_id END, changed_at = CASE WHEN task_state <> VALUES(task_state) AND ( VALUES(task_state) IN ('SUBMITTED', 'GRADED', 'RETURNED') OR (VALUES(task_state) = 'WORKING' AND task_state IN ('NOT_ENTERED', 'ENTERED', 'WORKING', 'RETURNED')) OR (VALUES(task_state) = 'ENTERED' AND task_state IN ('NOT_ENTERED', 'ENTERED')) ) THEN VALUES(changed_at) ELSE changed_at END, task_state = CASE WHEN VALUES(task_state) IN ('SUBMITTED', 'GRADED', 'RETURNED') THEN VALUES(task_state) WHEN VALUES(task_state) = 'WORKING' AND task_state IN ('NOT_ENTERED', 'ENTERED', 'WORKING', 'RETURNED') THEN VALUES(task_state) WHEN VALUES(task_state) = 'ENTERED' AND task_state IN ('NOT_ENTERED', 'ENTERED') THEN VALUES(task_state) ELSE task_state END, update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT state.state_id, user.dept_id, #{lessonId} AS lesson_id, #{questionId} AS question_id, student.student_id, COALESCE(state.task_state, 'NOT_ENTERED') AS task_state, COALESCE(state.state_version, 0) AS state_version, state.changed_at, user.nick_name AS student_name, student.student_no, student.entry_year, student.class_code FROM biz_student student INNER JOIN sys_user user ON user.user_id = student.user_id AND user.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN biz_student_task_state state ON state.student_id = student.student_id AND state.lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND state.question_id = #{questionId} WHERE user.dept_id = #{deptId} AND student.entry_year = #{entryYear} AND student.class_code = #{classCode} ORDER BY CAST(student.student_no AS UNSIGNED), student.student_no, student.student_id

SELECT student.student_id AS studentId, user.nick_name AS studentName, student.student_no AS studentNo, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM biz_lesson_question question WHERE question.lesson_id = #{lessonId}) AS totalQuestionCount, COUNT(state.state_id) AS startedQuestionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN state.task_state = 'ENTERED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enteredQuestionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN state.task_state = 'WORKING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS workingQuestionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN state.task_state = 'SUBMITTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS submittedQuestionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN state.task_state = 'GRADED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradedQuestionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN state.task_state = 'RETURNED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returnedQuestionCount, MAX(state.changed_at) AS changedAt FROM biz_student student INNER JOIN sys_user user ON user.user_id = student.user_id AND user.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN biz_student_task_state state ON state.student_id = student.student_id AND state.dept_id = #{deptId} AND state.lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biz_lesson_question relation WHERE relation.lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND relation.question_id = state.question_id) WHERE user.dept_id = #{deptId} AND student.entry_year = #{entryYear} AND student.class_code = #{classCode} GROUP BY student.student_id, user.nick_name, student.student_no ORDER BY CAST(student.student_no AS UNSIGNED), student.student_no, student.student_id
